item.title: Guest Commentary: The hidden ‘yes’ behind every ‘no’
item.description: After enough failed deals and broken promises, something deeper sets in: the belief that big change isn’t possible here, that ambitious investment is suspect, that disappointment is inevitable, and that survival is success. That mindset is more dangerous than any failed development project. The post Guest Commentary: The hidden ‘yes’ behind every ‘no’ appeared first on Richmond BizSense.

item.title: Make it a double: Distillery tasting room bill passed by GA, awaits Spanberger’s signature
item.description: The bill would allow Virginia distilleries to double the amount of liquor they can serve per customer at their tasting rooms from 3 ounces to 6 ounces. If approved, the new limit would equate to roughly four shots per customer. The post Make it a double: Distillery tasting room bill passed by GA, awaits Spanberger’s signature appeared first on Richmond BizSense.
